panels.description: RSS Memory (Resident Set Size): RSS is the portion of memory occupied by a process that is held in RAM. It includes all the memory that the process is actually using, which can include memory shared with other processes. It's a key indicator of the actual physical memory being used by a process. It is different than memory usage
